headline: ATL @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ATL 3.69 at BOS 2.98, with a projected total of 6.67. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (ATL -0.52, BOS -0.38), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.90, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -11.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Ranger Suarez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Willson Contreras, Ceddanne Rafaela, Wilyer Abreu, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Caleb Durbin, Jorge Mateo because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
